scope: Separate inspected acceptance passes from uninspected batch passes in pasted TIDs, list bulk actions and individual decisions, for both modes.

behavior.inspected: The existing actual-pass action retains acceptance_pass + acceptanceInspection=pass.
behavior.uninspected: The new action writes acceptance_pass + acceptanceInspection=uninspected + a common acceptanceBatchId with an explicit follow-batch note.
behavior.counts: Both actions count toward accepted status, acceptance pass volume and closed tasks. Uninspected passes do not enter personal, group or overall first actual acceptance accuracy.
behavior.scope: Single/multi isolation and top group scope remain enforced. Multiple groups within the same mode may be submitted together; original owners and groups are preserved.
behavior.safety: One transaction for the selected list; stale or invalid selected tasks abort every write. A fixed selection confirmation is used for list-based uninspected passes. Drafts are retained after conflicts.
behavior.historical: Existing saved events are not rewritten and accepted tasks cannot be resubmitted as pending tasks. No historical reclassification was performed.
behavior.unchanged: API, workflow, reports, original work mode and demo files. Existing group-based sampling semantics and batch returns remain in place.
behavior.performance: Reuses existing state and selected-row grouping. No extra polling, history aggregation or new network endpoint.

deployment.rollback: Restore backed-up index with candidate SHA guard; retain immutable assets.

proofs: 旧请求通过/不通过与显式普通实检保持原口径：六组各2合格/4实检，整体12/24=50%
单镜和多镜分别跨3组一次事务随批通过：通过量和闭环各增加6，原小组归属保留；个人/小组/整体首轮准确率完全不变
跨镜头、错误角色、分组不同batchId、缺失批次/版本、实检fail冒充通过、任一任务过期/已处理/重复均整批零写入
同名单并发只成功一个事务；原请求重复3次完全幂等，新请求重复点击409，验收通过量与随批通过量均不重复增加
首轮未实检退回后第二轮随批通过计入闭环但仍不补首验分母；全部旧事件、未选任务和原任务归属保持，数据库完整
